_comment: THE CANONICAL CONTENT OF THE HEADER STRING AND FOOTER, for BOTH public hosts.
tresane.com renders it through site-chrome.mjs (static HTML).
reading its own copy at tresane-360/content/chrome.json.
EDIT THIS FILE, then in tresane-360 run `node scripts/sync-chrome.mjs` to pull
the change across. A test there fails if the two copies disagree, so the drift
is caught in review rather than by someone noticing months later that one site
says Lexington and the other says Central Kentucky.
{R} is the site root: '' on the tresane.com home page so an in-page anchor
smooth-scrolls, '/' elsewhere on tresane.com, and the absolute tresane.com URL
on weqleader, where every one of these links is a trip back.

FOOTER: PAGES ONLY, NO ANCHORS. Settled with David Aug 27 2026. A footer is read by someone who has just finished the page, and a link that scrolls them back up it is the least useful thing you can offer there. Every footer link goes somewhere they have not been.
